description: This Java source file defines the class EcuAddressImpl, which implements the EcuAddress interface. The class handles ECU memory address representations, providing constructors and methods for managing addresses, including generating address arrays, converting them to bytes, and handling bit positions.

classes.name: EcuAddressImpl
classes.description: Final class implementing the EcuAddress interface, encapsulating ECU address management with various constructors and methods to generate address byte arrays, handle address padding, and manage address length and bit position.
